part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"yes","quote":"record a fixed batch of states from the target domain (including cloth-folding and dish-rack demonstrations), and measure how much each steering direction changes the policy's predicted action chunk in one batched forward pass; closed-loop rollouts are then spent only on the top-k features by divergence","reason":"Screens steering on recorded states via batched forward passes; closed-loop rollouts confirm only top-k features."},{"index":2,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Change the objective from per-feature rate estimation to best-arm identification: successive-rejects or UCB allocation that early-eliminates features whose effect is statistically bounded near zero, and replace the binary yes/no outcome with a per-step progress score","reason":"Adaptive allocation and lower-variance progress score, but every feature still needs full closed-loop episodes; no open-loop recorded-state scoring."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Change the measured quantity from success rate in sim to the transfer coefficient itself: for a small set of features, estimate each one's steering effect (success-rate delta) in both a deformable-object simulator and on real hardware, and measure the cross-domain rank correlation","reason":"Correlates sim and real effects from full closed-loop episodes in both domains; no open-loop scoring on fixed recorded observations."}]}
